problemStatement.plain: The cube root of 3 is irrational. This follows the same pattern as cube root of 2—the rational root theorem shows that x³ - 3 = 0 has no rational solutions.

proven: Proofs/CubeRoot3Irrational.lean proves irrational_cbrt3 using the same Mathlib irrational_nrt_of_notint_nrt template as the cube-root-of-2 proof.
The proof verifies cbrt3_cubed, proves three_not_perfect_cube from the bounds 1^3 < 3 < 2^3, and derives cbrt3_not_int.
Proof metadata records 5 theorems, 1 definition, 0 axioms, and 0 sorries, plus the alternative theorem irrational_three_pow_one_third.
open: A fully general Lean theorem for irrational nth roots of non-perfect powers remains the main reusable abstraction.
Degree-three algebraic-number and Eisenstein-irreducibility strengthenings remain future work.
knownResults.goal: Record cube-root-of-3 irrationality as the sibling instance showing the cube-root template generalizes cleanly.
